LanguageData.GoldReinforced.label: Reinforced gold
LanguageData.GoldReinforced.description: The most seductive metal of them all. Millions have died in attempting to feed the endless human thirst for gold. This soft metal is little use on its own, but is strikingly beautiful and very rare.
LanguageData.JadeReinforced.label: Reinforced jade
LanguageData.JadeReinforced.description: A hard, green stone. Because of its beauty and rarity, jade is often used for ornaments and decorations. It's hardness and density also makes it a good material for blunt weapons.
LanguageData.PlasteelReinforced.label: Reinforced plasteel
LanguageData.PlasteelReinforced.description: Advanced spacer tech structural material. Plasteel is extremely strong due to its unique molecular structure.
LanguageData.SilverReinforced.label: Reinforced silver
LanguageData.SilverReinforced.description: This metal is mostly used as a commodity currency. It can also be used for making attractive decorations.
LanguageData.SteelReinforced.label: Reinforced steel
LanguageData.SteelReinforced.description: An iron-carbon metal alloy used for building structures, tools, and weapons.
LanguageData.UraniumReinforced.label: Reinforced uranium
LanguageData.UraniumReinforced.description: An extremely hard, dense metal. While it is best known for its use powering nuclear reactors, its physical properties also make it excellent in some roles as a tool, weapon, or armor.
LanguageData.WoodLogReinforced.label: Reinforced wood
LanguageData.WoodLogReinforced.description: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures, weapons, and even simple prosthetics.
